name: wheel-size-mcp
description: MCP server for vehicle wheel and tire compatibility data — OEM specs, reverse fitment, e-commerce product cards, plus/minus sizing, and spec intelligence from wheel-size.com

tool_categories.catalog: Vehicle hierarchy lookups (makes, models, years, generations, modifications, regions)
tool_categories.search: Fitment data by vehicle, rim, or tire (user-initiated per API ToS)
tool_categories.classified: E-commerce product card generation with geometric fitment filtering
tool_categories.utility: Spec metadata with computed geometry and population intelligence
